```{r setup, include=FALSE}

library(haven)
library(dplyr)

# Import ELSA Wave 11 data
elsa <- read_dta("Raw data/wave_11_elsa_data_eul.dta")

# Check the dataset dimensions
dim(elsa)

knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

## Identification of pain and functional limitation variables

```{r}

# Identify variables related to pain and ADL

pain_vars <- names(elsa)[
  grepl("pain", names(elsa), ignore.case = TRUE)
]

adl_vars <- names(elsa)[
  grepl("^headl", names(elsa), ignore.case = TRUE)
]

# Display matching variable names
pain_vars
adl_vars

```

## Examination of variable labels and coding

```{r}

# Select candidate pain and basic ADL variables

candidate_vars <- c(
  "hepain",

  "headlwa",
  "headlba",
  "headlea",
  "headlbe",

# Check which variables are present
candidate_vars %in% names(elsa)

# Display descriptive variable labels
data.frame(

for (v in candidate_vars) {
```

```{r}

# Cross-tabulate pain screening and severity

pain_routing <- table(

knitr::kable(

# Display the cross-tabulation in the Console

```

## Derivation of the pain severity phenotype

```{r}

# Convert labelled Stata responses to readable categories
pain_screen <- as.character(haven::as_factor(elsa$hepain))
pain_severity <- as.character(haven::as_factor(elsa$hepaa))

# Derive an ordered pain severity phenotype
elsa <- elsa %>%
  mutate(
    pain_category = case_when(
      pain_screen == "No" &
        pain_severity == "Not applicable" ~ "No pain",
      pain_screen == "Yes" &
        pain_severity == "Mild" ~ "Mild",
      pain_screen == "Yes" &
        pain_severity == "Moderate" ~ "Moderate",
      pain_screen == "Yes" &
        pain_severity == "Severe" ~ "Severe",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    pain_category = factor(
      pain_category,
      levels = c("No pain", "Mild", "Moderate", "Severe"),
      ordered = TRUE
    )
  )

# Display the derived phenotype distribution
pain_summary <- table(
  elsa$pain_category,
  useNA = "ifany"
)

knitr::kable(
  pain_summary,
  caption = "Distribution of derived pain severity phenotype"
)

print(pain_summary)

```

## Assessment of activities of daily living variables

```{r}


# Define the six basic ADL variables
adl_vars <- c(
  "headldr",  # Dressing
  "headlwa",  # Walking across a room
  "headlba",  # Bathing or showering
  "headlea",  # Eating
  "headlbe",  # Getting in/out of bed
  "headlwc"   # Using the toilet
)

# Convert Stata labels to readable responses
adl_data <- elsa %>%
  select(all_of(adl_vars)) %>%
  mutate(across(
    everything(),
    ~ as.character(haven::as_factor(.x))
  ))

# Convert to a matrix for row-wise calculations
adl_matrix <- as.matrix(adl_data)

# Count ADL difficulties reported by each participant
adl_mentioned <- rowSums(
  adl_matrix == "Mentioned",
  na.rm = TRUE
)

# Identify invalid or non-substantive responses
valid_adl <- matrix(
  adl_matrix %in% c("Mentioned", "Not mentioned"),
  nrow = nrow(adl_matrix),
  ncol = ncol(adl_matrix)
)

adl_invalid <- rowSums(!valid_adl) > 0

# Summarise ADL classifications
adl_summary <- data.frame(
  classification = c(
    "No ADL difficulties",
    "One or more ADL difficulties",
    "Any non-substantive ADL response"
  ),
  n = c(
    sum(adl_mentioned == 0 & !adl_invalid),
    sum(adl_mentioned >= 1 & !adl_invalid),
    sum(adl_invalid)
  )
)

# Display results
knitr::kable(
  adl_summary,
  caption = "Preliminary classification of ADL responses"
)

print(adl_summary)

# Validate that all participants are accounted for
stopifnot(sum(adl_summary$n) == nrow(elsa))


```

## Derivation and validation of the ADL phenotype

```{r}

# Create provisional binary ADL outcome
elsa$adl_limitation <- ifelse(
  adl_invalid,
  NA_integer_,
  ifelse(adl_mentioned >= 1, 1L, 0L)
)

# Check the distribution
adl_check <- table(
  elsa$adl_limitation,
  useNA = "ifany"
)

print(adl_check)

# Validate expected counts
stopifnot(
  sum(elsa$adl_limitation == 0, na.rm = TRUE) == 6468,
  sum(elsa$adl_limitation == 1, na.rm = TRUE) == 1368,
  sum(is.na(elsa$adl_limitation)) == 6
)

# Cross-tabulate pain severity and ADL limitation
pain_adl_table <- table(
  Pain = elsa$pain_category,
  ADL = elsa$adl_limitation,
  useNA = "ifany"
)

print(pain_adl_table)

```

## Identification of participant identifiers and demographic variables

```{r}

# Search for potential participant identifiers,
# demographic variables and survey weights

candidate_names <- names(elsa)[
  grepl(
    "^(idauniq|id|age|sex|gender|wght|weight|wt)",
    names(elsa),
    ignore.case = TRUE
  )
]

# Display variable names and their descriptive labels
candidate_dictionary <- data.frame(
  variable = candidate_names,
  label = vapply(
    elsa[candidate_names],
    function(x) {
      lab <- attr(x, "label")
      if (is.null(lab)) NA_character_
      else as.character(lab)[1]
    },
    character(1)
  )
)

# Show candidate variables and labels
print(candidate_dictionary, row.names = FALSE)

```

## Validation of participant identifiers

```{r}

# Check participant identifier completeness
missing_ids <- sum(is.na(elsa$idauniq))

# Count unique participant identifiers
unique_ids <- dplyr::n_distinct(
  elsa$idauniq,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

# Count duplicated participant identifiers
duplicate_ids <- sum(
  duplicated(elsa$idauniq) & !is.na(elsa$idauniq)
)

# Display validation results
id_validation <- data.frame(
  check = c(
    "Total records",
    "Missing participant IDs",
    "Unique participant IDs",
    "Duplicate participant IDs"
  ),
  n = c(
    nrow(elsa),
    missing_ids,
    unique_ids,
    duplicate_ids
  )
)

print(id_validation)

```

## Identification of demographic variables using metadata

```{r}

# Extract descriptive labels from all variables
variable_labels <- vapply(
  elsa,
  function(x) {
    lab <- attr(x, "label")
    if (is.null(lab)) {
      NA_character_
    } else {
      as.character(lab)[1]
    }
  },
  character(1)
)

# Search for age and sex in variable descriptions
demographic_matches <- grepl(
  "\\bage\\b|\\bsex\\b|\\bgender\\b",
  variable_labels,
  ignore.case = TRUE
)

# Create a searchable metadata table
demographic_dictionary <- data.frame(
  variable = names(elsa)[demographic_matches],
  label = variable_labels[demographic_matches]
)

# Display the first 40 matches
print(
  head(demographic_dictionary, 40),
  row.names = FALSE
)

# Count all matches
cat("Total matching variables:",
    nrow(demographic_dictionary), "\n")

# Search for labels likely to describe the respondent
respondent_matches <- demographic_dictionary %>%
  filter(
    grepl(
      "respondent|age at interview|age in years|age at last birthday|sex of individual|sex of respondent",
      label,
      ignore.case = TRUE
    )
  )

# Display all matching variables
print(respondent_matches, row.names = FALSE)

cat(
  "Number of matches:",
  nrow(respondent_matches),
  "\n"
)


```
```{r}

# Search all variable names and labels for demographic clues
demographic_search <- data.frame(
  variable = names(elsa),
  label = unname(variable_labels)
)

demographic_search <- demographic_search %>%
  filter(
    grepl(
      "^(ind|age|sex|gender|dhsex|dhage|w11|dem)",
      variable,
      ignore.case = TRUE
    ) |
    grepl(
      "date of birth|year of birth|birth year|respondent.*sex|respondent.*age|individual.*age|individual.*sex",
      label,
      ignore.case = TRUE
    )
  )

print(demographic_search, row.names = FALSE)

```

```{r}

# Examine respondent age
summary(elsa$indager)

# Examine respondent sex categories
table(
  haven::as_factor(elsa$indsex),
  useNA = "ifany"
)

# Check missing values
sum(is.na(elsa$indager))
sum(is.na(elsa$indsex))

summary(elsa$w11xwgt)

```
## Investigation of special age codes
```{r}

# Display the labels associated with age values
attr(elsa$indager, "labels")

# Count all negative age values
table(
  elsa$indager[elsa$indager < 0],
  useNA = "ifany"
)

# Examine the age distribution excluding negative codes
summary(elsa$indager[elsa$indager >= 0])

```
## Derivation and validation of cleaned age
```{r}

# Create cleaned respondent age
elsa <- elsa %>%
  mutate(
    age_clean = case_when(
      indager == -7 ~ 90,
      indager %in% c(-9, -8, -1) ~ NA_real_,
      indager >= 0 ~ as.numeric(indager),
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  )

# Examine cleaned age distribution
summary(elsa$age_clean)

# Check missing values
sum(is.na(elsa$age_clean))

# Confirm that all 140 respondents aged 90+ are retained
sum(elsa$age_clean == 90, na.rm = TRUE)

# Validate the recoding
stopifnot(
  sum(elsa$age_clean == 90, na.rm = TRUE) == 140,
  all(
    elsa$age_clean[!is.na(elsa$age_clean)] >= 0
  )
)

```
## Assessment of cross-sectional survey weight availability
```{r}

# Identify participants with valid pain and ADL data
elsa <- elsa %>%
  mutate(
    eligible_pain_adl =
      !is.na(pain_category) &
      !is.na(adl_limitation)
  )

# Cross-tabulate analytical eligibility and weight availability
weight_availability <- table(
  Eligible = elsa$eligible_pain_adl,
  Weight_missing = is.na(elsa$w11xwgt)
)

print(weight_availability)

# Check whether available weights are positive
summary(elsa$w11xwgt)

sum(
  elsa$w11xwgt <= 0,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

```
## Validation of survey weights in the analytical sample
```{r}

# Classify cross-sectional weight availability
elsa <- elsa %>%
  mutate(
    weight_status = case_when(
      is.na(w11xwgt) ~ "Missing",
      w11xwgt == 0 ~ "Zero",
      w11xwgt > 0 ~ "Positive",
      TRUE ~ "Negative"
    )
  )

# Cross-tabulate eligibility and weight status
weight_status_table <- table(
  Eligible = elsa$eligible_pain_adl,
  Weight_status = elsa$weight_status
)

print(weight_status_table)

# Validate that all records are accounted for
stopifnot(
  sum(weight_status_table) == nrow(elsa)
)

```
## Survey weight availability by pain severity
```{r}

# Restrict to participants with valid pain and ADL data
eligible_data <- elsa %>%
  filter(eligible_pain_adl)

# Cross-tabulate pain severity against weight status
pain_weight_table <- table(
  Pain = eligible_data$pain_category,
  Weight = eligible_data$weight_status
)

print(pain_weight_table)

# Calculate percentage with positive weights
positive_weight_pct <- prop.table(
  pain_weight_table,
  margin = 1
)[, "Positive"] * 100

print(round(positive_weight_pct, 1))

```
## Survey weight availability by ADL limitation
```{r}

# Cross-tabulate ADL limitation and survey weight status
adl_weight_table <- table(
  ADL = eligible_data$adl_limitation,
  Weight = eligible_data$weight_status
)

print(adl_weight_table)

# Percentage with positive weights within each ADL group
adl_positive_pct <- prop.table(
  adl_weight_table,
  margin = 1
)[, "Positive"] * 100

print(round(adl_positive_pct, 1))

```
## Validation of ADL questionnaire responses
```{r}

# Examine the questionnaire's explicit "None of these" response
table(
  haven::as_factor(elsa$headl96),
  useNA = "ifany"
)

# Compare "None of these" with our derived ADL outcome
table(
  ADL_limitation = elsa$adl_limitation,
  None_of_these = haven::as_factor(elsa$headl96),
  useNA = "ifany"
)

# Convert explicit "None of these" responses to labels
none_response <- as.character(
  haven::as_factor(elsa$headl96)
)

# Validate consistency with the derived basic ADL outcome
stopifnot(
  sum(
    elsa$adl_limitation == 1 &
      none_response == "Mentioned",
    na.rm = TRUE
  ) == 0,

  sum(
    elsa$adl_limitation == 0 &
      none_response == "Mentioned",
    na.rm = TRUE
  ) == 5907,

  sum(is.na(elsa$adl_limitation)) == 6
)

cat("ADL consistency validation: PASSED\n")

```
## Construction of the analysis-ready dataset
```{r}

# Construct the analysis-ready dataset
ard <- elsa %>%
  filter(eligible_pain_adl) %>%
  transmute(
    participant_id = idauniq,
    pain_category = pain_category,
    adl_limitation = adl_limitation,
    age = age_clean,
    sex = haven::as_factor(indsex),
    cross_sectional_weight = w11xwgt
  )

# Check the dimensions
dim(ard)

# Check missingness in each variable
colSums(is.na(ard))

# Check participant identifier uniqueness
stopifnot(
  nrow(ard) == 7395,
  !anyNA(ard$participant_id),
  dplyr::n_distinct(ard$participant_id) == nrow(ard),
  !anyNA(ard$pain_category),
  !anyNA(ard$adl_limitation),
  !anyNA(ard$age),
  !anyNA(ard$sex)
)

cat("ARD construction and validation: PASSED\n")

```
## Final validation of analysis-ready variable structure
```{r}

# Examine variable types and structure
str(ard)

# Check the distribution of pain categories
table(ard$pain_category, useNA = "ifany")

# Check the distribution of ADL limitation
table(ard$adl_limitation, useNA = "ifany")

# Check sex categories
table(ard$sex, useNA = "ifany")

# Validate permitted values
stopifnot(
  all(ard$adl_limitation %in% c(0, 1)),
  all(ard$age >= 0 & ard$age <= 90),
 
all(
  as.character(ard$pain_category) %in%
    c("Not often troubled by pain",
      "Mild", "Moderate", "Severe")
)

  )

cat("ARD variable structure validation: PASSED\n")

# Convert the ARD from a tibble to a standard data frame
ard <- as.data.frame(ard)

# Remove unused sex categories
ard$sex <- droplevels(ard$sex)

# Confirm the object type
class(ard)

# Inspect the structure
str(ard)

```
```{r}
levels(ard$sex)
table(ard$sex)
```
## Export the analysis-ready dataset
```{r}

# Create an output folder if it does not exist
dir.create("outputs", showWarnings = FALSE)

# Save the validated analysis-ready dataset
saveRDS(ard, file = "outputs/ELSA_W11_pain_ADL_ARD.rds")

# Read the saved file back to verify it
ard_check <- readRDS("outputs/ELSA_W11_pain_ADL_ARD.rds")

# Confirm the saved dataset matches the original
stopifnot(
  identical(ard, ard_check),
  is.data.frame(ard_check),
  nrow(ard_check) == 7395
)

cat("ARD saved and verified successfully\n")

```

```{r}
    "Unique cross-wave participant identifier",

    "Difficulty with at least one of six basic ADLs",
    "Age in years, with ages 90 and above coded as 90",
    "Definitive recorded sex",
    "Wave 11 cross-sectional survey weight"
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Display the dictionary
print(data_dictionary, row.names = FALSE)

```
